title: Periyar Arivulagam is Dravidian model government’s brainchild, says Stalin
description: Stalin also listed several library and other knowledge-centre projects undertaken by the DMK government, including the Anna Centenary Library in Chennai, the Kalaignar Centenary Library in Madurai, Mudhalvar Padaippagams, and the renovation of the Connemara Public Library in Egmore
